en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Abi’l-Qasim Majilawayh, from Muhammed bin Ali al-Kufi, from Uthman bin Isa, from Abdullah bin Sinan, from some of our companions, that he said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, say:

The woman is only (like) a necklace, hence, look at what you place around your neck. A woman has no equal, neither for her good, nor for her bad. As for her good, her equal is not gold and silver; she is better than gold and silver. As for her bad, her equal is not sand; sand is better than her.
